source.author: ov
source.text: Nec fingam causas; tu tantum fida sorori esse velis prolisque meae matertera dici.
source.text_original: Nec fingam causas; tu tantum fida sorori / esse velis prolisque meae matertera dici.
source.text_english: I will not invent excuses; only be willing to be faithful to your sister and to be called the aunt of my child.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: illumetu tantum non indignantibus undis hoc caput accipias et pressam regibus alnum.
reuse.text_original: †illumetu tantum / non indignantibus undis / hoc caput accipias et pressam regibus alnum.
reuse.text_english: may you receive this head, the waves almost not indignant, and the alder-tree, pressed down by kings.
